high_stakes_advice.instructions: state.text is the main content of one public web page (title and H1 first), written in state.lang (vi = Vietnamese, en = English), possibly cut at the end. state.site is the website name. Judge only this text. Does the page give specific advice or instructions where a mistake could seriously hurt the reader's health, money, safety or legal situation (for example dosages, investment actions, legal steps, electrical work)? Answer no for general background information.

expert_shown.instructions: state.text is the main content of one public web page (title and H1 first), written in state.lang (vi = Vietnamese, en = English), possibly cut at the end. state.site is the website name. Judge only this text. Does the text name an author or reviewer and state a relevant qualification or experience for this topic (for example a doctor for medical advice, a lawyer for legal steps, a licensed adviser for finance)? Answer no when no person is named or no relevant qualification is stated.

consensus_conflict.instructions: state.text is the main content of one public web page (title and H1 first), written in state.lang (vi = Vietnamese, en = English), possibly cut at the end. state.site is the website name. Judge only this text. Does the page make claims that contradict well-established expert or official consensus on the topic, or present a fringe claim as settled fact? Answer no when claims match mainstream expert guidance or are clearly labeled as opinion or uncertain.
